items.docs: Request an asynchronous export of a specific cohort. This is the first step in a three-step process to download cohort membership data. After requesting, poll the status endpoint, then download the file when ready.

params.name: cohort_id
params.description: The ID of the cohort whose export status to check.

items.docs: Poll the status of a previously requested cohort export. Returns the current state of the export job. Continue polling until the status indicates the export is complete.

params.name: cohort_id
params.description: The ID of the cohort to download.

items.docs: Download the exported cohort membership data file. This endpoint should only be called after the export status indicates completion.
Create or update a cohort by uploading a list of user IDs or Amplitude IDs. This allows importing audience segments from external systems into Amplitude for analysis and targeting.
